setup_sql: CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id TEXT, amount INTEGER); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1, 'ada', 10), (2, 'ada', 20), (3, 'lin', 7); CREATE TABLE notes (order_id INTEGER, note TEXT); INSERT INTO notes VALUES (1, 'first'), (1, 'second'), (2, 'third');

cases.question: What is the total order revenue for each customer?
cases.sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id
